record.title: Poipet vegetable-vendor blockade over private shipping documentation fees
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.scope: Friendship Bridge, Cambodian side of Poipet–Klong Luek/Aranyaprathet international land crossing
record.direction: Vehicle movement across bridge; documented queue on Thai approach.
record.movement: Vehicle passage, particularly Cambodia-bound cargo; pedestrian extent unestablished.
record.imposing_authority: Cambodian traders acting as non-state protesters
record.enforcement: Contemporary reports describe actual obstruction and same-day release/dissolution.
record.consequences: Reported cargo queue; exact volume not independently verified.
record.relationship: Distinct dated blockade; not continuous with other Poipet vendor protests.
record.status_observation: Historical event only; no present-status inference.
record.official_rationale: Vendors protested increased charges; named customs chief denied fruit/vegetable tax and report traced charges to private shipping documentation fees.
record.context: Deliberate coercive physical blockade of an international crossing, not an ordinary customs check.
record.uncertainty: Single opened reporting lineage. Alleged customs tax rise was denied by named customs chief; report attributes increased charges to private shipping employees. Do not encode a government tax increase or state border closure. Dissolution reported10am; uniform traffic normalization not observed.
